correctness.rationale: Concavity of lambda_min(C^(1/2)DC^(1/2)) in diagonal sampling probabilities and within-community permutation symmetry yields a globally sufficient block-uniform sampler. For first-block mass t the spectrum has (p−1) copies ut, (q−1) copies v(1−t), plus smaller 2x2 mean-mode eigenvalue g(t); this proves optimization of min{ut,v(1−t),g(t)}. g has unique maximum t_Q=(s+c)/(r+s+2c) and value (rs−c²)/(r+s+2c). At t0=v/(u+v), testing Q−hI yields determinant (ab−c²)t0(1−t0), proving transition c²=ab. Monotonic crossings and determinant equalities produce remaining branch formulas. Independent rational four-phase witnesses, numerical one-dimensional optimizations and an unbounded gain family corroborate all phases. Limits require p,q≥2, a,b∈(0,1), c>0 and strict SPD.
